event_name: Date 16 September 2018 Time 20:49 2018 SINGAPORE GRAND PRIX 13 - 16 September 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Incident between cars 11 and 31 in turn 3.
offence: Involved in an alleged incident as defined by Art 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that neither driver was wholy or predominantly at fault for the incident at Turn 3. Shortly after the start, at the approach to turn 3, car No. 11 was between cars No. 31 and No. 8. Car No. 31 was on his right side and they made contact, while navigating the corner, as the three cars were nearly side by side at the time.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
team: Racing Point Force India F1 Team
title: Doc 32 2018 Singapore Grand Prix Decision Car 11 Incident With Car 31
